density_note.body: Surface symbols locate epithelial populations. Density is qualitative, not measured cell abundance.

shared_note.body: One shared L-cell field: GLP-1, GLP-2, PYY and oxyntomodulin.

role_GIP.body: Glucose-dependent insulin release; adipose / bone effects

role_GLP1.body: Insulin up; glucagon / gastric emptying down; satiety

role_GLP2.body: Intestinal mucosal growth and repair (indirect pathways)

role_SOMATOSTATIN.body: Local inhibition of neighboring secretory cells

mechanism_context.body: FED / luminal cue, cell activation and basolateral secretion

mechanism_effect.body:
Glucose-dependent insulin
increase; glucagon and
gastric emptying decrease;
satiety increase

mechanism_route_note.body: Conceptual sequence: elapsed time and signal size are not physiological measurements.

mechanism_route_note2.body: Brain / gut effects may involve neural and indirect pathways; arrows show functional connections.

fasting_note.body: Wave overlay represents migrating motor activity; not luminal nutrient transit.

fasting_ghrelin_note.body: Ghrelin: pre-meal hunger signal from fundic P/D1 cells.

comparison_subtitle.body: Oral glucose vs IV glucose at MATCHED plasma glucose

comparison_note.body: Illustrative normalized curves, not experimental data. GIP and GLP-1 are the two incretins.

comparison_explanation.body: Greater insulin after oral glucose reflects the incretin contribution.
